prompt: This is a debugging round. A Kafka producer for our account-events pipeline used to key every record by the raw `accountId`, so all events for one account landed on the same partition and stayed in FIFO order. After a recent deploy, on-call is reporting that events for individual accounts are now processed out of order — nothing about the consumers or partition-assignment logic changed obviously. The same deploy also introduced event schema versioning and bumped the topic's partition count. Here is the producer's key-building code: walk me through why ordering broke for a single account, and state the invariant that was violated.
